description:
Instrument tip contacts tissue or surface briefly, but without a clear manipulation
intent (no grasp/pull/split/dissection/energy).

Visual exploration of the cavity/field to find anatomical landmarks or the
next worksite, without a clear tissue manipulation goal.

Instrument grasps tissue/structure and holds it (stable grasp) to control, secure,
or prepare for another operation.

Instrument(s) moving in the scene without meaningful contact/manipulation of tissue
(e.g., repositioning, passing through the field).

Traction/retraction action where tissue is pulled to expose or tension an area
(continuous pulling/holding under tension).

The view is essentially stable: camera stays on a site, tools are almost not moving,
typically waiting/pausing (e.g., surgeon waiting, assessing, or holding position).
Camera zoom-in to magnify the worksite or improve visibility.
